# ClusterTriage

> ClusterTriage is independent Windows Failover Cluster assurance: measuring,
> assessing, remediating and verifying Hyper-V, Failover Cluster and Azure
> Local environments throughout the year. A read-only PowerShell collection
> runs at the customer; the distinguishing part is the report, built from
> measured state rather than a checklist. ClusterDown is the separate,
> incident-focused entry point for a cluster that is down or unstable now.

Hans Vredevoort, 40+ years in Microsoft infrastructure, more than a decade as
a Microsoft MVP for Failover Clustering, co-founder of Hyper-V.nu. Rob
Scheepens, performance, observability and Windows internals.

## Assurance

- [ClusterTriage Assurance](https://clustertriage.com/en/assurance/) ([NL](https://clustertriage.com/nl/assurance/)): the four-measurement annual assurance cycle - baseline, verify, drift, assure
- [Method](https://clustertriage.com/en/methodology/) ([NL](https://clustertriage.com/nl/methodologie/)): the real measurement toolchain, from intake and collectors through grading to findings and reports

## Incident response

- [ClusterDown](https://clusterdown.com/en/) ([NL](https://clusterdown.com/nl/)): free, read-only Cluster Triage - the five heaviest signals around an incident window, sorted by severity
- [After an incident](https://clusterdown.com/en/after-an-incident/) ([NL](https://clusterdown.com/nl/na-een-storing/)): root cause analysis once triage points at something

- [About](https://clustertriage.com/en/about/) ([NL](https://clustertriage.com/nl/over-ons/)): Hans Vredevoort and Rob Scheepens
